images.caption: Figure 8:Tempo ratio composition.Each vertical slice is one recording, sorted independently per strip by mean level; colors give the duration share at each tempo level relative to the reference. A recording mixes tempo levels when at least two colors each cover at least 5% of its slice.

Figure 9:Octave-offset composition.Each vertical slice is one unit (a passage or a recording), sorted independently per strip by mean offset; colors give the share of matched notes at each octave offset from the reference. A unit mixes octaves when at least two colors each cover at least 5% of its slice.
